description:
Define a Cell-side resubscribe message (e.g. `{:cell_resubscribe, subscriber}`) and matching `handle_info` in LV/LiveComponent that re-runs `Filament.Cell.subscribe` for the affected slot.

Mirror the Subscriber path's resubscribe wiring (search for `:filament_observable_resubscribe` in `lib/filament/live_view.ex` ~215, `lib/filament/observable/gen_server.ex`, and `lib/filament/hooks.ex` for `:needs_resubscribe`).

Coverage: a test that simulates server death + restart and asserts the component re-subscribes and resumes receiving updates.
title: Add Cell resubscribe semantics
